results.title: Zogsool
results.overview: The vast Mongolian grassland stretches across the screen, with blue skies and beautiful clouds filling half the frame. Underneath, an oil tanker truck drives for some time along a scenic road, before coming to a stop in front of a small town. When the town is suddenly sealed off due to the COVID pandemic, Sumber, the oil tanker driver, is quarantined at the gas station. Khanda, a single mother who manages the station while being exploited for sex and labor by a corrupt government official and the greedy owner, is now also tasked with looking after Sumber.

results.title: American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
results.original_title: American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
results.overview: Against political resistance and industry skepticism, Luis Valdez pushes Chicano storytelling from the fields to the film screen with Zoot Suit and La Bamba, crafting iconic works that challenge, celebrate, and expand America’s story.

results.title: A Russian Winter
results.overview: After the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many people in Russia faced a brutal choice: prison, the army – or exile. Margarita, Yuri and their friends are caught in the crosscurrents of history, with no way to return home, but also no place where they feel truly welcome.

results.title: The Whisper of Sunlight
results.overview: Set in Hong Kong, Wong closely observes patients and their families during their final days as they grapple with the difficult questions surrounding access to a costly experimental drug that may offer them a last hope. The film sensitively explores the vulnerability and uncertainty that accompany rare and devastating illnesses.

results.title: Last Reckoning
results.overview: A parolee determined to stay out of trouble finds a duffel bag full of gangsters' cash in his trunk and must decide whether to return it to protect his loved ones or flee to save himself.

results.title: A Long Ride Home
results.overview: Mick learns about the death of his father through a phone call. Now he needs to return to a home he hasn't been to in 25 years to face his Demons.  Director J. Robert Bellamy originally wanted this story to be told in film format, but would only get funding to make it as a series for Bell Fibe. This version is his definitive vision.

results.title: GW:s mord – Skultunamordet
results.overview: The morning calm is broken in Skultuna and Rönnby in Västerås when a VMA is sent out and residents are asked to stay indoors. The police are hunting a 38-year-old suspect after two brutal violent crimes. A child calls 112 and says that his mother is being attacked. Shortly afterwards, a woman is found dead in her home. Leif GW Persson examines the case and the legal process.

results.title: Chromatic
results.overview: In a world where at 18, blood color defines societal value, three siblings await the day the Chromacy dictates their future. When Lucas's blood reveals a shocking truth, their fate takes a dark turn, forcing them into a fight for survival.

results.title: Magic Atlas
results.overview: A magician arrives in the reclusive coal empire of Luocha, triggering widespread panic in a society already simmering beneath a fragile peace.

results.title: Whispers of a Burning Scent
results.overview: On the day of a decisive court hearing and an important wedding performance, a quiet wedding musician finds his private life exposed to public scrutiny. Accused of exploiting his marriage, he moves between courtroom, city streets and stage, carrying the weight of judgment, loyalty, and unspoken guilt.

results.title: Brigitte Bardot - Le combat en héritage
results.original_title: Brigitte Bardot - Le combat en héritage
results.overview: Marking the 40th anniversary of the Brigitte Bardot Foundation—established in 1986—and coming just months after the icon's passing on December 28, 2025, this program explores BB's true legacy. Joined by numerous guests, Stéphane Bern paints a portrait of a woman who transformed her fame into a powerful tool for driving action, legislation, animal rescues, and public mobilization on behalf of the animal cause.

results.title: Guilty, the AI Said
results.overview: A rookie judge testing a powerful AI verdict system finds herself at odds with the technology when it condemns a teenage patricide to death before the trial even begins.

results.title: The Mrs. Wolf Show
results.overview: A friendly housewife, an unsuspecting salesman, and a live studio audience. What could go wrong?

results.original_title: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 12
results.overview: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 12 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on February 23, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan and served as the final show of the tour.

results.title: Femmes d'Agadez
results.overview: Agadez, a desert city in northern Niger, is weighed down by geopolitical interests and the harsh European border policy. The filmmaker weaves testimonies of three courageous women who each, in their own way, try to confront this reality. They speak about their work, their role in the community, and how they put solidarity into practice. Their inspiring stories offer a glimpse of a feminism that is not theoretical, but rooted in everyday life—a feminism that is truly practiced and lived.
